lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Ereivyn border. The trees get dense fast from here.
lines.lens: Canopy closes within thirty meters. Visibility drops. Good for ambush, bad for retreat.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.monologue: He stopped walking. His hands are shaking but not from fear.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: The forest is... pulling. Like it knows me. Or something in me knows it.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: Like a door I used to use. The threshold is here. I can feel where it thins.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: I see— hands. Not mine. Placing something into the roots. Something that glowed.
lines.monologue: His eyes unfocused. Whatever he's seeing, it's not here.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: It's gone. The image just... folded back.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: I think so. It wasn't painful. Just... incomplete. Like reading a word you've forgotten the meaning of.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: We'll find the rest of it.
lines.monologue: Concern, yes. But also curiosity. His magic responds to places. That's not nothing. That's a map.
